intro: Timor-Leste is a democratic republic with an elected president and parliament.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is directly elected; José Ramos-Horta took office again in 2022. The prime minister, Xanana Gusmão since 2023, leads the government. The National Parliament has 65 members.

chapters.title: A young democracy
text: Timor-Leste is rated one of the freest democracies in Southeast Asia.

keyTerms.meaning: A system with both an elected president and a prime minister.
